column1: # Hand edits to the clue lists. Overrides wordnet.tsv.
#   ANSWER<tab>New clue      replace a clue (or add an answer)
#   ANSWER<tab>-             take the answer out of the pool
# Answers must be in the guess dictionary. A clue may not contain its answer.
# Rude words are welcome: they're real words. Slurs are not. The clue generator never uses a sense
# WordNet labels as a slur, but these answers are mainly known today as slurs, so they're out even
# though each has a neutral sense. They stay valid guesses.
